curated_studies.evidence_location: provider abstract (not full text or source dataset)

curated_studies.reported_unit_and_count: 128 marine-sting presentations; 116 syndrome cases; 50 skin-scraping participants
curated_studies.interpretation: Two components from the same period; do not add 50 to 128 or assert individual overlap without original records. Species attribution and syndrome outcome benchmark.

curated_studies.interpretation: Published geographic and severity comparisons; earlier Cairns series may overlap; source identity and independence not established.

Public share landing page resolved through the catalogue; page needs JavaScript; no actual ZIP bytes. Earlier catalogue label references an October 2017 extract, so identify release from actual archive metadata rather than link text.
public_source_access.disposition: Use the ordinary custodian-provided download on approved device; preserve attribution/terms and privacy; no event narrative in Git or public Hub.

decision.next: Acquire authorised original archive and public aggregate workbook; reconcile definitions, source provenance, release overlap and feasible comparison; validate source-specific extraction only if actual evidence requires it.
